about: The priest asks the Holy Trinity to receive the offering made in memory of Christ's passion, resurrection and ascension, and in honor of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the saints. In the final petition, their intercession in heaven corresponds to the keeping of their memory on earth.

s01.narrative: At the middle of the altar, the priest bows slightly and rests his joined hands upon it.

s02.translation: Receive, holy Trinity, this offering, which we offer Thee in memory of the passion, the resurrection and the ascension of Jesus Christ our Lord: and in honor of blessed Mary ever Virgin, and of blessed John the Baptist, and of the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and of these, and of all the Saints: that it may profit them unto honor and us unto salvation: and may they deign to intercede for us in heaven, whose memory we keep on earth. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

w003.function: The vocative is the same as the nominative. The address settles it.

w010.function: “Ob” governs the accusative and means “on account of”. “memóriam” (w059) returns near the prayer's end.

w014.function: The third of three genitives depending on “memóriam” (w010): the Passion, Resurrection and Ascension.

w021.function: “Ob memóriam” refers to Christ, while “in honórem” refers to the saints.

w035.function: The list corresponds to the Confíteor but omits Michael the Archangel and adds “istórum” (w037).

w042.function: Dative of advantage: it is to be of honor to them.

w049.function: It corresponds to “honórem” (w045): honor to the saints and salvation to us.

w054.function: The infinitive completing “dignéntur” (w055): “to intercede for us”.

w062.function: “cælis” (w057) modifies the saints' intercession, while “terris” modifies the keeping of their memory.

w064.function: Accusative singular of “idem”, agreeing with “Christum” (w065): “through the same Christ”.
